title: Nepal Cities Weather

panels.title: Nepal cities · weather at a glance

options.content:
### Kathmandu · Pokhara · Biratnagar
Nepal time (UTC+05:45) · Units: °C, km/h, mm. Dashboard refresh: **10 seconds**; provider downloads: **5 minutes**.
[Weather data by Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com/) · Model-based estimates, not ground-station measurements. Check source age and download status before interpreting readings. Charts build history while collection runs.
